cards.title: 说明
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定。

body.p: 2024 年适应性测试的写作包括应用文和读后续写，分别为 15 分和 25 分。应用文约 80 词。续写约 150 词，分两段，每段用给定的段首句开头。依据：G8 第 11 页、G9 第 12 页。
本课用客观题检查两类任务，限时 6 分钟。完整的应用文在应用文练习中写，建议用时 12 分钟。完整的续写在续写练习中写，建议用时 25 分钟。

groups.text:
假定你是学校园艺社负责人李华。社团将举行一次种子交换活动，请给外教 Morgan 写邮件邀请参加，并说明活动安排及回复方式。

Points: invite Morgan to the seed exchange; give the time and place; ask Morgan to reply by Friday.

items.stem: Which opening states the purpose of the email?
options: I would like to invite you to our seed exchange.
I am writing to cancel our seed exchange.
I am pleased that the exchange has already ended.
I would like to ask you to organize the exchange.
items.why: 任务要求邀请 Morgan 参加种子交换活动，第一项明确表达邀请。

items.stem: Which draft addresses the request for an activity arrangement?
options: Last year's seed exchange in the school garden was popular.
The exchange will take place in the school garden on Saturday.
The exchange took place in the school garden last Saturday.
The exchange will be described in a report next week.
items.why: 要点要求 give the time and place。第二项写明周六、学校花园，是即将举行的活动的安排。第三项说的是已经结束的活动。

items.stem: Which sentence asks for the required response?
options: Please send the seeds to me before Friday.
Please announce the exchange after Friday.
Could you let me know by Friday if you can attend?
Could you confirm that the exchange ended on Friday?
items.why: 要点要求 ask Morgan to reply by Friday。第三项请 Morgan 在周五前告知能否参加。

items.stem: Which greeting and signature match the stated sender and recipient?
options: Dear Li Hua, … Best regards, Morgan
Dear Morgan, … Best regards, Gardening Club
Dear Gardening Club, … Best regards, Morgan
Dear Morgan, … Best regards, Li Hua
items.why: 写信人是园艺社负责人李华，收件人是外教 Morgan。第四项称呼 Morgan，署名 Li Hua。

groups.text:
On the first Saturday of the holidays, Jun and his grandfather went to the community garden. Their task was to prepare a small bed for the children's planting day. Jun carried a wooden box of tools, while his grandfather brought a packet of seeds and an old notebook. In the notebook were drawings of the garden from years before.

At the gate, they met Ms. Park, who looked after the garden. She pointed to a narrow bed beside the path. A sign usually marked the bed, but the sign had disappeared during a windy night. Without it, the children might mistake the young plants for weeds. Ms. Park asked Jun and his grandfather to find the sign before the children arrived that afternoon.

Jun remembered seeing a board near the tool shed the previous week. He ran there, but found only a stack of empty pots. His grandfather checked behind the shed and found a length of string. It looked like the string that had held the sign to its post, but there was no board nearby.

They followed the path around the garden, looking under benches and between rows of vegetables. Jun grew impatient. He wanted to start digging, and he suggested making a new sign instead. His grandfather agreed that a new sign might be needed, but first he wanted to check one more place. He opened the notebook and showed Jun an old drawing. A low fence stood behind the shed; a narrow space separated it from the wall.

Jun had never noticed that space. He fetched a small garden rake from the tool box and walked back with his grandfather. At first, they could see only fallen leaves. Then Jun noticed a corner of painted wood beneath them. It was too far back to reach by hand. He looked at the rake and then at his grandfather.

Paragraph 1: Jun slid the rake carefully into the narrow space.
Paragraph 2: When the children arrived, the sign was back beside the bed.

items.stem: What should the first paragraph plausibly develop?
options: Jun uses the rake to pull the board within reach.
Jun reaches into the narrow space with his hand.
Jun uses the rake to dig the bed before the children come.
Jun uses the rake to clear leaves from the path.
items.why: 前文说木板 too far back to reach by hand，段首句写 Jun 把耙子伸进窄缝。第一项用耙子把木板拉到手边，正好接上。第二项与 too far back to reach by hand 矛盾。

items.stem: Which first-paragraph event prepares for the second paragraph's opening?
options: Jun and his grandfather leave the sign behind the shed.
Jun and his grandfather return the recovered sign to the bed.
Jun and his grandfather make a new sign for the bed.
Jun and his grandfather show Ms. Park the old notebook drawing.
items.why: 第二段开头写 the sign was back beside the bed，第一段要写找回原来的标牌并放回去，即第二项。第三项做的是新标牌，与 back 不符。

items.stem: Which detail can help Jun locate the sign without adding a new clue?
options: The empty pots stacked beside the shed.
The seed packet carried by his grandfather.
The painted corner visible under the leaves.
The children's tools beside the garden gate.
items.why: 原文最后写 Jun noticed a corner of painted wood beneath them。第三项用的就是这一已有线索，不需要新增情节。

items.stem: Which ending follows the sign's return and the planting day's purpose?
options: The children mistake the young plants for weeds.
The children move the missing sign into the narrow space.
The children leave the plants unmarked and close the gate.
The children recognize the bed and begin their planting.
items.why: 标牌的作用是让孩子们不把幼苗当成杂草。标牌放回后，第四项写孩子们认出花圃并开始种植，符合 planting day 的目的。第一项正是标牌要避免的情况。
